$comment: Community-maintained new-grad job feeds the hourly alerter watches.
These are the same lists people follow by hand on GitHub; reading them here means a posting
is judged against the owner's actual resume instead of skimmed off a README.
Prefer `json` sources: SimplifyJobs publishes a typed listings.json with real posted dates,
active flags and sponsorship, so nothing has to be recovered by parsing a markdown table.
`markdown` is the fallback for repos (speedyapply) that publish no structured file at all.
